meta.name: TACEDGE colour tokens
meta.note: Source of truth for TACEDGE colour. Do not add colours. CMYK values are mathematical conversions: Indicative CMYK — verify with the selected printer and stock. No Pantone values are published until validated on press (see docs/decisions-required.md D3).

primary-dark.role: Primary TACEDGE hero green. Dominant dark surface: headers, footers, dark sections, primary buttons, report covers.
primary-dark.a11y: Cream on primary-dark 14.97:1 (AAA). White on primary-dark 16.35:1 (AAA).

primary-dark-hover.role: Hover state for primary-dark buttons; secondary green for line icons on light grounds.
primary-dark-hover.a11y: Cream on hover 13.1:1 (AAA). As icon/text on card 13.87:1.

contour-on-dark.role: Topographic contour linework on primary-dark surfaces only. Stroke 1.1px, opacity 0.45. Decorative — never carries information.
contour-on-dark.a11y: Decorative only; below contrast thresholds by design.

logo-forest.role: PROVISIONAL — REQUIRES FINAL APPROVAL (D1). Green used inside logo artwork on light grounds and the app-icon tile. Never a UI, surface or text colour.
logo-forest.a11y: 9.49:1 on cream — the wordmark stays legible at minimum sizes.

utility-sage.role: Working mid-tone. Secondary marks, muted accents, process arrows, checklist ticks.
utility-sage.a11y: 4.05:1 on cream, 4.42:1 on white — large text and icons only. Not for body text.

sage-edge.role: Green hairline; selected edge; icon rings on tinted panels.
sage-edge.a11y: Hairline/decorative. 7.89:1 against primary-dark when used as a ring on dark.

pale-sage.role: Quiet mid surface. Utility labels on dark surfaces; the brandmark colour.
pale-sage.a11y: 7.73:1 on primary-dark (AA for any size, AAA for large).

sage-tint.role: Soft green fill: chips, tinted callout panels, icon containers, lead copy on dark surfaces.

warm-cream.role: Page background — the brand paper. Text and logo colour on primary-dark surfaces.

card-surface.role: Card and component surface on cream or tint pages.

quiet-tint.role: Faint green-grey fill: quiet panels, alternating sections and table rows.

stage.role: Backdrop behind device frames and product imagery compositions only.
stage.a11y: Backdrop only — no text directly on stage.

primary-text.role: Primary text on light surfaces. Also the monochrome logo ink.

secondary-text.role: Secondary and supporting text on light surfaces.
secondary-text.a11y: 5.8:1 on cream, 6.33:1 on white (AA all sizes).

muted-text.role: Utility text: captions, metadata, eyebrow labels. Corrected value — supersedes the stale #8A8F80 listed on the website styleguide page.
muted-text.a11y: 5.13:1 on cream, 4.9:1 on quiet-tint, 4.6:1 on sage-tint — AA (≥4.5:1) on every approved light surface.

border.role: Standard 1px card and component border on light surfaces.

border-strong.role: Stronger border: secondary buttons, emphasised card edges.

divider.role: Horizontal rules and step-marker connector lines.

focus.role: Focus outline on light surfaces: 2px solid, 2px offset. On dark surfaces the focus outline switches to warm-cream.
focus.a11y: 14.97:1 against cream; cream outline 14.97:1 against primary-dark.

success.role: Terminal-positive state. TACEDGE uses forest-filled components for confirmed/complete — there is no separate bright green. Forest fill is reserved for terminal-positive states.

warning.role: Caution status: ageing, submitted-awaiting-review, variance. Product UI and faithful UI mocks only. Never decorative, never a marketing accent.
warning.a11y: 3.61:1 on white — large text, icons and badges only. Pair with primary-text for body copy on warning-tint (12.42:1).

warning-tint.role: Caution fill behind warning badges and rows.

error.role: Alert status: issue, test-fail, incident, stale. Product UI and faithful UI mocks only. Never decorative.
error.a11y: 6.73:1 on white, 5.17:1 on error-tint, 6.16:1 on cream — AA at all sizes.

error-tint.role: Alert fill behind error badges and rows.

information.role: Informational status shares utility-sage. TACEDGE has no blue: neutral information is carried by the green family and typography, not a new hue.
information.a11y: Large text and icons only on light surfaces (4.05:1 on cream).
